scriptData.label: @effect.name
Broken Leg (Minor)

description.label: Description
description.value:
The bullet hammers into your thigh, piercing flesh and muscle, then ricocheting off the long bone before exiting off to one side in a spray of red. The bone cracks from the impact, sending you to the ground, groaning and cursing.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (2), @Condition[Bleeding] (1) and Prone. Also suffer a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.7mCcI3q7hgWcmbBU]{Broken Bone (Minor)}.

No Extraction is necessary.
